summary: Initializes a 52-byte matrix/struct at a1 from SSE constants and the __m128 result of EmptyStub_8bd0. Row 0 is a fixed constant (xmmword_8D61D0); the low component of xmmword_8D61C0 is placed at +0x10 and +0x2C, the full vector at +0x30; partial stores from the EmptyStub result and an XOR of its shuffled value with xmmword_8D61B0 fill +0x14/+0x1C/+0x24. Returns a1.

operations.description: Call EmptyStub_8bd0 with four arguments (Hex-Rays frame slots v7-v10 at ebp-44h..ebp-38h); its __m128 return is the base for the shuffle/XOR computation.
Write the 16-byte constant xmmword_8D61D0 to a1+0 as the output matrix row 0.
Write the low dword component of xmmword_8D61C0 to a1+16.
Store the low 8 bytes (two floats) of the EmptyStub result vector to a1+20.
Store the low 8 bytes of xmmword_8D61C0 to a1+28.
Write the low dword component of xmmword_8D61C0 to a1+44 (0x2C).
Store the low 8 bytes of shuffle(v5, 0x11) XOR xmmword_8D61B0 to a1+36 (0x24).
Write the full __m128 value of xmmword_8D61C0 to a1+48 (0x30) as the output matrix row 3.
Return a1 (result register set to the output pointer).
